Brain Editor properly saves temperature and max_tokens via PUT /api/admin/agents/{agent_id}/brain endpoint
CSV export generates proper sections: USERS, AGENT USAGE, PAYMENTS, SUMMARY with Content-Disposition header for download
All data-testid attributes properly implemented: toggle-active-{agent_id}, brain-temperature, brain-max-tokens, export-csv-btn
